plain: Make the model answer with extra instructions in its prompt, then train it to give those same answers without them, so the behavior becomes its default.
eli5: Whisper hints to the robot while it practises, then keep practising until it does the right thing without the hints.
technical: Generate targets from a model prompted with additional context or instructions, then fine-tune the model on (input without that context, target) pairs so the conditioned behavior is distilled into the weights (Snell, Klein and Zhong, 2022).
